name: GameStorm
blurb: Portland, Oregon's annual tabletop, board-game and RPG convention, run by the nonprofit Oregon Science Fiction Conventions.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'GameStorm 27 will be March 18-21, 2027 at the Holiday Inn Portland - Columbia Riverfront.'

notes: The seed URL gamestorm.org would not connect (ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT, tried default and msedge channels) across two separate attempts; the convention's real current site is this Google Sites page hosted under the organizer's own osfci.org domain.
